documents.unit: Office of the Provost / AI Committee
documents.title: Artificial Intelligence at Duquesne
documents.summary: The Provost's page offers broad, preliminary AI guidance for faculty and students and leaves the decision to schools, departments and individual courses. It supplies three sample syllabus statements (open, moderate, restrictive), a sample AI-citation prompt, and rules on faculty use of AI around data privacy, assessment and email.
documents.stance_why: The page says the guidance is "intentionally broad" and that "Student AI use is governed by individual course syllabi"; it offers three template statements ("permissive, limited and restrictive/no use") rather than one rule, so it delegates.

units.why: The page frames the effort as responding to AI growth and the need to integrate tools "ethically, safely, and effectively", a purpose statement for the framework (P56 rather than P44 because it states purpose, not a skill claim).
